meetings.title: Our Agreements
settings.title: Your Data & Boundaries
settings.consent.note: Each permission separate. All off by default and off again after page reload.
settings.consent.visibility: Show My Profile to Participants — what you get: pilot participants see what you can help with.
settings.consent.comparison: Compare My Profile with Others — what you get: system shows you only to those with mutual benefit.
settings.consent.introduction: Allow Introduction to Conversation — what you get: contacts open only after two "yes".
settings.consent.externalAi: External AI for Profile Draft — what you get: text structuring; request only with your consent.
settings.consent.recording: Meeting Recording — unavailable — what you get: protection; no recording in pilot (StGB 179ter).
settings.consent.summary: Meeting Summary — what you get: short "why this pair" explanation after your consent.
settings.consent.analytics: Anonymized Pilot Stats — what you get: operator sees pilot funnel; nothing written without consent.
settings.hideNote: Hide profile in "My Profile" section. Messenger-shared card copies stay with recipients.
